doc: The game's drop tables (default inventories): what a container, an enemy or a plant gives, with counts and chances.

ids.rule: Drop tables have no names in the game. A table that templates use is named after the first of them in name order, in lower case (game:lootcontainer_enemy_scavenger_melee01); a table no template uses is game:drops_<first 8 hex digits of its GUID>. When two tables would get the same name, the one that held it first keeps it and the other is game:<name>~<first 8 hex digits of its GUID>. A table's GUID also selects it (as data packs' drops section does today).

entries.doc: The table's stacks in walk order (root group first, then its groups). Index i in a field path (entries[3].chance) is that order.

item.doc: The item. Given when an entry is appended; read-only afterwards.

weight.doc: The weight of the entry in a group that picks one.
